student.notes: A Spanish learner in both formal and informal contexts. He is a musician and pianist, so he has a preference for auditory learning. He is curious and very interested in culture. Strong points: he is communicative, sociable and unafraid of making mistakes. He is a strategic speaker with strong intuition built up over years of interacting with Spanish speakers.
